label: TP
reason: Using java.util.Random() for session token generation is insecure; Random() uses a predictable PRNG suitable only for simulations, not cryptographic purposes. Session tokens require cryptographically strong randomness. The XSS finding is a false positive as traced below.

evidence.note: Uses java.util.Random().nextDouble() to generate session key - insecure for auth tokens
XSS finding is FP: user='Donna'+class-derived suffix, cookie name/value from server-side vars only
